vocabulary.meaning: 在外面；在……范围之外；外面的

examples.text: Furthermore, job satisfaction would seem to be causing overall happiness, not the other way around.
examples.translation: 此外，看起来是工作满意度带来了整体幸福感，而不是反过来。
examples.speechText: Furthermore, job satisfaction would seem to be causing overall happiness, not the other way around.

examples.text: Today, when children are exposed（expose的过去分词形式） to technology at a younger age, parents often find themselves lagging behind in computer skills.
examples.translation: 如今，当孩子在更小的年龄就接触到了科技时，父母常常发现自己在电脑技能方面已经落后了。
examples.speechText: Today, when children are exposed to technology at a younger age, parents often find themselves lagging behind in computer skills.

examples.text: Videos of her theatrical demonstrations have attracted hundreds of millions of views across social media platforms（platform的复数形式）.
examples.translation: 她那些富有戏剧性的演示视频，在各大社交媒体平台上吸引了数亿次观看。
examples.speechText: Videos of her theatrical demonstrations have attracted hundreds of millions of views across social media platforms.

examples.text: The road was wet this morning.
examples.speechText: The road was wet this morning.

examples.text: You can watch your favorite movie or sports match.
examples.translation: 你可以看自己最喜欢的电影或体育比赛。
examples.speechText: You can watch your favorite movie or sports match.

examples.text: For example, a Monday morning chat about your weekend may offer added value if you can really build up a personal bond with your colleagues.
examples.translation: 例如，如果你能真正与同事建立私人层面的联系，周一早上聊聊周末经历就可能带来额外价值。
examples.speechText: For example, a Monday morning chat about your weekend may offer added value if you can really build up a personal bond with your colleagues.

examples.text: But garden experts warn — not too fast.
examples.translation: 但园艺专家提醒说：别急着动手。
examples.speechText: But garden experts warn — not too fast.

examples.text: You can watch your favorite movie or sports match.
examples.translation: 你可以看自己最喜欢的电影或体育比赛。
examples.speechText: You can watch your favorite movie or sports match.

examples.text: They dream of placing enzymes in the automobile to monitor exhaust and send data on pollution to a microprocessor that will then adjust the engine.
examples.translation: 他们设想在汽车中安置酶来监测尾气，并把污染数据传送给微处理器，再由微处理器调节发动机。
examples.speechText: They dream of placing enzymes in the automobile to monitor exhaust and send data on pollution to a microprocessor that will then adjust the engine.

examples.text: Bob’s constant complaints and criticism made Sandy confused（confuse的过去分词形式） and irritated.
examples.translation: Bob不停地抱怨和批评，让Sandy感到困惑和恼怒。
examples.speechText: Bob’s constant complaints and criticism made Sandy confused and irritated.

examples.text: Think about hiking（hike的-ing形式） or biking for a part of your trip, too.
examples.translation: 也可以考虑在部分旅程中徒步或骑自行车。
examples.speechText: Think about hiking or biking for a part of your trip, too.

examples.text: Released from these household chores, many wives have found jobs outside the home.
examples.translation: 从这些家务中解脱出来后，许多妻子找到了家庭之外的工作。
examples.speechText: Released from these household chores, many wives have found jobs outside the home.

examples.text: “Let us go, won't you?” the crooks said to the policeman.
examples.translation: “放我们走吧，好不好？”那些罪犯对男警察说道。
examples.speechText: “Let us go, won't you?” the crooks said to the policeman.

examples.text: Still, Fitz Patrick has mixed（mix的过去分词形式） feelings about the speed cameras.
examples.translation: 不过，菲茨・帕特里克对测速摄像头的感受还是很复杂。
examples.speechText: Still, Fitz Patrick has mixed feelings about the speed cameras.

examples.text: The little girl jumped from behind the door to welcome her father.
examples.translation: 小女孩从门后跳出来，迎接她的父亲。
examples.speechText: The little girl jumped from behind the door to welcome her father.
